{{Top}}
{{Quote|There's always a bigger fish.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=TheresAlwaysABiggerFish-TPM.flac|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
[[File:Fish.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Fish on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].]]
'''Fish''' were [[Water/Legends|water]]-dwelling creatures that came in many varieties throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Types of fish ranged from the [[goldie]], harmless peaceful fish sometimes used to create a peaceful atmosphere in a room, to the vicious [[Eel/Legends|eel]] known as the [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]], one of the most vicious predators of the [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
